title: Decision
description: AGT-A1: the single shape every driver emits from decide(ctx). A Decision is a PROPOSAL (AGT-A6) — it executes nothing; commit-service validates it against the context's vocabulary and sim-core resolves it.

vocabulary.description: The vocabulary id this decision claims to be drawn from, e.g. 'combat_v1'. Must equal the vocabulary the dispatcher offered — a mismatch is a reject.

tool.description: Tool name. MUST be a member of the vocabulary's closed set; anything else rejects to the vocabulary's fallback_tool.

params.description: Arguments, validated against the named tool's parameter schema in the vocabulary file.

rationale.description: Optional flavor for narration. NEVER enters the event log (EVT-A8) and never affects validation.
